ingestionTime.description: Timestamp when the MPIP product record was ingested by the collector

reportName.description: Name of the source report file the record was extracted from

reportFolder.description: Folder or interface path from which the source report was collected

product_name.description: Product file name from the filename field of the source JSON node

ingestion_date.description: Product ingestion date from the ingestionDate field of the source JSON node

validity_start_time.description: Product validity start time from the validityStartTime field of the source JSON node

validity_stop_time.description: Product validity stop time from the validityStopTime field of the source JSON node

interface_name.description: Collector interface name set to MPIP_GMV

production_service_type.description: Production service type set by the collector to MPIP

production_service_name.description: Production service name set by the collector to GMV
